requirements.title: Accurate, exactly nested boundaries from the latest open data
acceptance: Boundaries come from the latest OSM extract, with the extract date recorded
Every unit lies inside exactly one parent; the levels have no gaps or overlaps beyond 1 m²
The coastline and islands follow OSM natural=coastline at full precision

requirements.title: Six partitions: country, regions, districts, governorates, delegations, sectors
acceptance: There are 1 country, 7 regions, 5 districts and 24 governorates
Delegations and sectors match the documented counts
The district composition follows Decree 2023-589

requirements.title: Multiple levels of detail (full, high, medium, low, tiny)
acceptance: Each partition is available at the documented levels of detail
Tolerances and file sizes are documented in a table

requirements.title: Multiple visual modes
acceptance: The plain, outline, light, dark, labelled (Latin), labelled (Arabic), nested and interactive modes are generated
Every SVG is valid XML and renders in browsers and on GitHub

requirements.title: Semantic identifiers and multilingual names
acceptance: Every shape has a stable id and data-* attributes holding the ISO/INS codes and the Arabic, French and English names
Attribute tables are published as CSV and JSON

requirements.title: GeoJSON and TopoJSON companions plus a projection helper
acceptance: WGS84 GeoJSON and TopoJSON are produced per partition and level of detail
project(lon,lat) places points on the SVG within 1 SVG unit

requirements.title: Reflect delegations created after 2014 where open data allows
acceptance: Each post-2014 delegation is either rebuilt from its documented imadas or listed as a known limitation

requirements.title: World-class documentation and README crediting the author
acceptance: The README has a hero visual, a gallery, quick start, partitions/levels/modes tables, usage examples and credits
The README credits Alaa Taieb as creator
docs/ covers methodology, accuracy, usage, projection and the build

requirements.title: Open-source project hygiene
acceptance: MIT licence for code and ODbL for data, with OSM attribution
CONTRIBUTING, CODE_OF_CONDUCT, CHANGELOG, CITATION and issue templates are present

requirements.title: Reproducible build and automated validation
acceptance: One command rebuilds dist/ from data/source
npm test validates counts, IDs, nesting, XML validity and size budgets
CI runs the tests on every push

requirements.title: No topographic layers, tile server or web-map library in v1
